rationale: All feasible runs are setup-limited at ss/100C/max-RC by a port path, so T_eff ≈ 0.2×target + d and period stays 0.45; hold +0.1 ns, slew/cap 0, DRC converges, wire ≈ estimate. Round 2 reproduced bm64 exactly (d 3.85, reg-to-reg 4.37): margins, cap% and RC model change nothing at this loose target, so repeats waste runs. Keep what mattered: timing-driven placement, DELAY 3 (reg-to-reg below d/0.8, unlike AREA 2's 5.2 ns, which would bind at re-run), post-GRT timing off (on in the DELAY 3 failure), slew ≥30% (~165 vs 97 buffers). Test lower density (best d at 30-35%, worst at 36-41%); TPE varies utilisation for distinct designs. PL margin 0.3 guards tight re-runs.
